verdict.rationale: Unleash documents an Admin API that gives programmatic access to all resources, including feature flags, projects, environments, users and integrations. The same API powers the Admin UI and supports automation workflows, and API tokens are documented for tools and automation. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of using the Admin API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: The Admin API provides full programmatic access to manage all resources within Unleash, including feature flags, projects, environments, users, and integrations.
This API powers the Unleash Admin UI and enables automation workflows.
Unleash uses API keys to facilitate communication between consuming clients such as SDKs, Unleash Edge, or other tools and automation.
